title: How Your Phone Lights Up Instantly

segments.text: Ever wonder how your phone lights up instantly?
When you flip a switch, lithium ions leave the anode.
They travel through the liquid electrolyte toward the cathode.
Electrons race along the external wires from anode to cathode.
At the anode, an oxidation reaction splits lithium atoms into Li⁺ and e‑.
At the cathode, a reduction reaction reunites Li⁺ and e‑ into the material.
These half‑reactions lower the cell’s chemical potential, turning stored energy into current.
That’s why your phone lights up instantly.
